// A hue rotation with saturation scaling and lightness offset.
// SaturationScale of 1 and LightnessOffset of 0 leave those axes unchanged.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV)
type HueSaturationAdjustment
    implements IValue
{
    HueShift: Angle;
    SaturationScale: Number;
    LightnessOffset: Number;
}
